title: Beach, Coast, Shore
credits: Andrew Smith wrote this lesson for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: This week on Ask a Teacher, we answer a question from Doyeon in Korea about the usage of three similar words.
sentences.zh: 本周的"问老师"栏目，我们回答了来自韩国多贤的一个问题，关于三个相似词的用法。

sentences.en: Here is the question:
sentences.zh: 以下是这个问题：

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I want to know the differences between
sentences.zh: 我想知道

sentences.en: the beach, . . . coast and shore.
sentences.zh: 海滩、……海岸和岸边的区别。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You ask a useful question, Doyeon.
sentences.zh: 你问了一个很有用的问题，多贤。

sentences.en: Beach, shore and coast are related words, but they have some important differences.
sentences.zh: 海滩、岸边和海岸是相关的词，但它们有一些重要的区别。

sentences.en: Beach
sentences.zh: 海滩

sentences.en: The word “beach” is the most specific of the three words.
sentences.zh: "海滩"这个词是三个词中最具体的。

sentences.en: The Collins online dictionary defines beach as “a nearly level stretch of pebbles and sand beside a sea, lake, etc., often washed by high water.”
sentences.zh: 柯林斯在线词典将海滩定义为"海边、湖边等附近几乎平坦的砾石和沙滩地带，常被高潮水冲刷"。

sentences.en: Ocean beaches are popular places to visit.
sentences.zh: 海洋海滩是受欢迎的游览胜地。

sentences.en: We often use the phrase “at the beach” to express the idea of spending time in the general area of the beach, as in the following example:
sentences.zh: 我们经常用"在海滩"这个短语来表达在海滩一般区域度过时光的意思，如下面这个例子：

sentences.en: They will vacation at the beach this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天他们将在海滩度假。

sentences.en: We usually say “on the beach” when describing specific activities we do there:
sentences.zh: 当我们描述在那里进行的具体活动时，通常说"在海滩上"：

sentences.en: She went for a walk on the beach.
sentences.zh: 她去海滩散步了。

sentences.en: I’m going to spend my afternoon on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我打算下午在海滩上度过。

sentences.en: They are playing football on the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们正在海滩上踢足球。

sentences.en: Coast
sentences.zh: 海岸

sentences.en: The Learning English Word Book defines coast as “land on the edge of the ocean.”
sentences.zh: 《学习英语词汇》将海岸定义为"海洋边缘的土地"。

sentences.en: We can use the word to describe a wide area, however.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们也可以用这个词来描述一个很大的区域。

sentences.en: For example, Baltimore, Maryland is an East Coast city even though it is several kilometers from the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 例如，马里兰州的巴尔的摩是一座东海岸城市，尽管它距离大西洋有好几公里。

sentences.en: Here are more examples of how we can use “coast” in a sentence.
sentences.zh: 以下是更多关于我们如何在句子中使用“coast”的例子。

sentences.en: The Florida coast has many nice towns and beaches.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达的海岸有许多美丽的城镇和海滩。

sentences.en: The coast of California extends over 1,300 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚的海岸绵延1300多公里。

sentences.en: Like the expression “at the beach,” we can say “on the coast” when describing the general area, as in the following example:
sentences.zh: 就像表达“at the beach”一样，在描述大致区域时，我们可以说“on the coast”，如下例所示：

sentences.en: Her mother has lived on the coast for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 她母亲在海边生活了30年。

sentences.en: We can use the expression “off the coast of” to describe an area of ocean or sea relative to a place on land:
sentences.zh: 我们可以用表达“off the coast of”来描述一片海洋或海域相对于陆地上某一位置的关系：

sentences.en: The island is about 60 kilometers off the coast of Africa.
sentences.zh: 这座岛屿位于非洲海岸以外约60公里处。

sentences.en: Shore
sentences.zh: 海岸（shore）

sentences.en: The Merriam-Webster online dictionary defines the word “shore” as “the land bordering a usually large body of water.”
sentences.zh: 《韦氏 Webster 在线词典》将“shore”一词定义为“通常与一大片水域相邻的陆地”。

sentences.en: Shore can sometimes mean the beach, but not always.
sentences.zh: “shore”有时可以指海滩，但并非总是如此。

sentences.en: For example, you might swim to shore and come out of the water onto a beach.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可能会游向岸边，从水中游到海滩上。

sentences.en: But you could also come to shore at a port with no beach in sight.
sentences.zh: 不过，你也可能抵达一个望不见海滩的港口上岸。

sentences.en: And we can use “shore” when discussing the general area, just like we do with the word “coast.”
sentences.zh: 在讨论大致区域时，我们也可以像使用“coast”一样使用“shore”。

sentences.en: The following example shows this meaning:
sentences.zh: 下面的例子展示了这一含义：

sentences.en: The northern shore has many nice towns and beaches.
sentences.zh: 北岸有许多美丽的城镇和海滩。

sentences.en: For our readers and listeners, what are your questions about American English?
sentences.zh: 对于我们的读者和听众而言，你们关于美式英语有哪些问题呢？

sentences.en: We want to hear from you!
sentences.zh: 我们想听听你们的意见！

sentences.en: Do you like to spend time at the coast?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢在海边度过时光吗？

sentences.en: Send us an email at learningenglish@voanews.com.
sentences.zh: 请将邮件发送至 learningenglish@voanews.com。

sentences.en: And please let us know where you are from, too.
sentences.zh: 同时，也请告知我们您来自哪里。

sentences.en: And that’s Ask a Teacher.
sentences.zh: 以上就是“向老师提问”栏目。

sentences.en: I’m Andrew Smith.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·史密斯。

glossary.def: precise, relating to one thing and not others
